title: A* Search
subtitle: Find the shortest path on a grid using heuristic-guided search that combines cost-so-far with estimated cost-to-goal.
complexityNote: Optimal with admissible heuristic. Combines Dijkstra's algorithm with greedy best-first search.
steps: f(n) = g(n) + h(n) where g = cost so far, h = heuristic
Add start to open set with f = h(start)
Pick node with lowest f from open set
Expand neighbors, update costs if better path found
Reconstruct path when goal is reached
